title: Browser account creation and email-verification recovery controls
goal: Use actual browser signup/email-verification recovery without confusing syntactic pairing context, account creation, mail-service response, verified-query banner or OAuth handoff with verified email, session, desktop approval, MFA or operational entitlement.
prerequisites: Internal source-only local preview, not customer help or accepted live auth. No real account, email/password/token/session/credentials/provider/database/runtime configuration was read.

Start account creation from installed Agent pairing context. Client parses a valid-shaped desktop callback, while server separately requires a pending unconsumed unexpired challenge. Account creation is not approved production access.

Scope newly fills signup/Check your email/shared verification recovery and narrow proof/credential guards; native sign-in/browser pairing guides stay separate. Full sign-in/OAuth/provider MFA/password reset/enterprise claims are excluded.
permissions: Signup terms checkbox and callback/challenge are not execution grants. Server checks accepted terms, challenge/expiry, rate limits and password bounds; current verified-email+password authorization remains separate from UI/API200/navigation.

Reviewed current shared synchronous authInFlight gate serializes credential/OAuth initiation and mirrors preexisting terms/challenge UI gates; it changes no backend auth/entitlement policy or genuine approval boundary.

Verification/resend can mutate account-token state or attempt mail; verification GET can update identity. Source documentation never invokes those operations or supplies permission to replay uncertain auth.

No MFA enrollment/TOTP/recovery-code/password-reset form found in inspected mounted auth/account scope. Enterprise MFA-claim comment is not a UI; do not invent a flow or infer no upstream/provider MFA.

steps.expectedState: verified=1 query alone is display, not proof visitor verified or got session/pairing. Actual credentials callback requires stored passwordHash/emailVerifiedAt, normalized-email rate limit and password comparison; identity-store errors deny. Membership bootstrap/entitlement/pairing remain separate.

steps.expectedState: No automatic resend/signup replay or inferred account rollback. Resend recovery is not MFA or password reset. Existing browser pairing/native identity storage/entitlement/operation approval must independently succeed; no live acceptance here.

recovery: For invalid/expired desktop signup context return to Agent and start intended sign-in again; no guessed challenge or extension of old request.
After delivery failure or lost create response, account may exist. Use displayed verification recovery/manual sign-in/support guidance rather than blind repeated creation or another identity.
Neutral resend does not confirm delivery/account. New unused link can replace old even if delivery fails; try later/contact support per display rather than treating old link as still valid.
Invalid/expired/used proof has no success; temporary503 provides specific retry-link guidance. Do not share/replay token links in support or claim a session from verified query.
